senses.gloss: m. (= h. מָרוֹן; v. אִימַר a. preced.) rebellion. בני א׳ rebels.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18a:13">R. Hash. 18ᵃ</cite> (translating <he>בני מרון</he> Mish.) (all creatures pass before the Lord for receiving their decrees) <he>כבני א׳</he> like rebels (after surrender brought before a court martial; cmp.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 1</cite>, s. v. <cite ref="A02638"><he>אפופסין</he></cite>, a.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:3:6">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite>). [Rashi <he>אמרנא</he> = Syr. <he>אֵמרונא</he> ‘like young lambs passing singly to be marked for tithes’.]
